newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs to consolidate after LIFFE gains.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs to consolidate after LIFFE gains.

text.p: Key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are expected to consolidate above 125.00 on Thursday in Tokyo, after overnight gains on LIFFE.
The benchmark futures contract rose as high as 125.20 on LIFFE on Wednesday, after closing at 125.03 in Tokyo.
"The June is likely to consolidate between 125.00 and 125.50 after rising in London overnight. However, activity is likely to be thin ahead of a long weekend," said a brokerage house trader.
Japan's financial markets will be closed next Monday for a national holiday.
Traders said JGBs' upside is likely to remain heavy.
"We may see some short-covering in JGB futures. But cash JGBs are likely to be heavy as people are still waiting for chances to sell," said a trader at a city bank's securities unit.
Traders said supply concerns are continuing to weigh on JGBs, as more Japanese companies are expected to launch straight bonds next week.
The recent strength in Tokyo stocks was also making players cautious, traders said.
"We will be watching whether the Nikkei continues to rise towards 20,000. If so, the upside for JGBs could become even heavier," said the brokerage house trader.
The Nikkei 225 stock average closed up 480.75 points at 19,151.12 on Wednesday.
